flagged.title: Redemption, the Church and the Mystery of Salvation
flagged.reason: At 03:54, the video attributes the quote 'God predestines no one to go to hell' to CCC section 1033 instead of CCC 1037, which would cost students a mark on questions requiring a named source of authority.

mark_affecting.quote: check out this authoritative quote from the Catechism, section 1033: 'God predestines no one to go to hell.'
